sourceEnglish.transcription_method: Line-wrap whitespace normalized; item text, ordering, response labels and two-week frame preserved. No new attention items or altered symptom text.
sourceEnglish.prompt: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?

items.text: Feeling nervous, anxious or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying
Worrying too much about different things
Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
Feeling afraid as if something awful might happen

selectedForm: NCBI-hosted GAD-7_v2.doc standalone form: seven scored symptoms only, no impairment question appended

platformInstructionsNotOriginalItems.draftNotice: AI 辅助生成的简体中文研究工作译稿，尚未验证，未获得原开发者对本译稿的审校或认可。原始量表许可允许翻译，但不代表开发者认可本译稿。仅供文本、计分与报告方案审查，不供实际施测或临床使用。
platformInstructionsNotOriginalItems.missingResponsePolicy: 您可以跳过问题或退出；七个症状问题未完整且合法作答时不计算总分。这是本平台的保守草稿策略，不是声称原作者规定的唯一规则。
platformInstructionsNotOriginalItems.supportNotice: 本工具不是诊断或自杀风险评估，分数低也不能排除需要帮助的情况。若持续感到困扰，可寻求合格专业人员的评估。若正处于即时危险或无法保证自身安全，请立即联系当地急救服务，并寻求可信赖的人陪伴。此页面无人实时监测，不会自动联系您或安排援助。
platformInstructionsNotOriginalItems.displayRequirement: Unconditional before/during answering and in reports, including incomplete attempts. Separate from original item wording; not linked to score thresholds.
